run_visual_bert_sweep: run the visual bert hyperparameter sweep for VQA2 training using the default grid
get_grid_hyperparams: get the hyperparameter grid for visual bert VQA2 training with batch size and learning rate variants
configure_visual_bert_training: configure visual bert training hyperparameters including batch size, learning rate, and scheduler settings
postprocess_hyperparams: postprocess a given hyperparameter configuration before each sweep run
define_hyperparam_values: define hyperparameter values with optional save directory key lambdas for sweep naming
